query: Oh, did I tell you I finally got that little rescue kitten I was talking about last week? She’s already causing so much trouble, yesterday she knocked over my whole potted succulent and spread dirt all over the kitchen counter. I spent almost an hour cleaning it up, and she just sat on the fridge watching me like she did nothing wrong at all. Oh right, the reason I’m messaging you today: I need to cancel my pending order #W9373487 because the items are no longer needed, and for my delivered order #W7449508, I’d like to return item 6477915553, with the refund going back to the payment method gift_card_7711863 please.
